issues.description: Resource IDs are interpolated into URL paths without escaping, allowing path/query injection such as '../admin?x=1'.
Transport failures such as timeouts and connection resets are neither retried nor wrapped in LumenAPIError.
Malformed response items are silently skipped instead of raising, which can hide API regressions and data loss.
Retry-After only accepts numeric seconds and ignores valid HTTP-date Retry-After values.
max_attempts is not validated, so zero or negative values produce a misleading no-request error path.
batch_create materializes the entire iterable before chunking, making large inputs memory-heavy despite the streaming-friendly API shape.
Literal enum fields from API data are not runtime-validated, so invalid statuses or verdicts can enter typed models.
Error.retryable uses bool() coercion, so string values like 'false' become True.
The typed package does not include a py.typed marker, so downstream type checkers will not treat it as PEP 561 typed.
